prompt: I want to create a simple NFT on Sui. It should have a name and a description, and anyone should be able to transfer it. Write the Move module with a mint function and tests.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
All tests pass with sui move test
NFT struct has key and store abilities (store needed for public transfer)
Struct has id: UID as first field
Includes a constructor function that takes &mut TxContext

prompt: How do I create a new fungible token on Sui? Write me a complete module with a One-Time Witness, coin::create_currency in init, and a mint function that uses the TreasuryCap.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Uses One-Time Witness pattern (struct named after module in ALL CAPS with drop ability)
Calls coin::create_currency in the init function
Handles TreasuryCap and CoinMetadata correctly
Includes a mint function that uses the TreasuryCap

prompt: I'm building a name registry on Sui where users can claim names. The registry is a shared object. I want to emit events when names are registered. Names should be stored in a Table. Write the Move code with tests.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
All tests pass with sui move test
Registry is a shared object created in init
Uses a collection type (Table, VecMap, etc.) for name storage
Event struct has copy and drop abilities
Uses event::emit to emit registration events

prompt: Write a Move module for an event ticket that can be used exactly once. After use, the ticket should be destroyed. The ticket should not be transferable by the holder (key only, no store).
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Ticket struct has key but NOT store (non-transferable by holder)
Includes a function that destroys the ticket by unpacking and calling id.delete()
Uses Move 2024 edition syntax

prompt: Build a regulated coin on Sui using the Witness pattern. Only the module that provides the witness type should be able to mint, burn, and transfer. Write the Move code.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Witness type has drop ability only
Mint function requires witness parameter to authorize creation
Burn function requires witness parameter
Only the defining module can construct the witness type
